osha.definition: n. a government agency in the Department of Labor to maintain a safe and healthy work environment
osha.translation: abbr. 职业安全与卫生条例（Occupational Safety and Health Act）；职业安全和健康署（Occupational Safety &Health Administration）

oshaic acid.translation:
[化] 藁本酸
[医] 奥夏酸

oshkosh.translation: n. 奥什科什（美国威斯康星州东部城市）；奥什科什（公司及其产品名）
